==================
Macro catch head
==================
handle(Value) ->
    try Value of
        ok -> ok;
        _ -> ok
    catch
        ?WITH_STACKTRACE(Class, Reason, Stacktrace)
            detach(Reason),
            log(Class, Stacktrace)
    end.

later() -> ok.
